# Batch35 — invitation inputs, pairing feedback and transparency

PR #2212 / acceptance #2186, 2026-10-19. iOS 26 Simulator, 402 × 874, installed native `494a20f1eb4f0666a2c90bc3c758af4e7ff5f46b`. Baseline `9a51bc6028cdcc7c8beb5a8bfcc30a8a1755f98c`; candidate source `2bc5aa4ed229c8ed46ee762ae8d8cd0e2f6d5790` with successful CI run 39150908461. Subsequent evidence commits do not change this tested application source.

These are actual native screenshots, visually inspected before publication. The small floating gear is the development-client overlay. Only malformed local input was used: no valid invite, pairing offer, authentication or resource creation. Viewport, locale, text size and theme match within each before/after pair; status-bar time and transient system overlays naturally differ.

## Driver limits and unqualified gates

First failures were kept in private diagnostic records. A driver confused the field's text value with its stable accessibility label; corrected to use the label. Bounded synthetic scrolling did not reach the maximum-size Cancel; screenshot-grounded content drags did. A Settings row-center tap did not toggle the switch; only clicking the visible switch changed both Settings and native readback. One Workspaces tap raced app startup; its capture was replaced after readiness. Accessibility rectangles sometimes clip a fully visible button; screenshots were inspected before the actual taps.

System Settings and the keyboard display missing Chinese glyphs. No published Chinese or long translated-name acceptance is claimed. The invitation recipient/email screen requires an independently scoped owner session and was not accessed under this signed-out lease. Its style change still needs native before/after capture. Physical iOS, Android, older iOS, the full intermediate/maximum/theme matrix, other generic Sheets, busy rendering, real QR/share, invitation Hosted AuthKit/PKCE and identity/revocation paths remain untested here. Live VoiceOver/TalkBack is deferred by the Human.

## Restoration and release

The original runtime Host/cloud configuration and session summary matched: zero paired Hosts and no active cloud session. No credential or remote session operation was performed. Original app Documents (2 files) and Preferences (1 file) were restored byte-for-byte after the app stopped. Only one newly created, verified empty `{}` draft file, absent from the baseline, was archived privately and removed. Original light theme, `large` text size, preferences and Reduce Transparency off were restored. No global language change or clipboard operation was performed; launch-only language overrides ended with the app process.

Own driver and Metro were stopped, the shared checkout restored with its original untracked documents, and the queue explicitly released. Other drivers, Hosts, physical phone and Prod were untouched. No native build, install, dependency cleanup or recording was made. Batch34's separate prior-session uncertainty was neither inherited nor cleared by this signed-out verification. #2186 remains open; #2212 is unmerged.
